generator: SHA256 counter blocks: SHA256(domain ASCII + byte00 + seed32 raw bytes + counter uint64 little endian), counter starts0, digest interpreted as16 uint16 little endian. No RNG library. Distinct domains and seeds. Each u yields centered triangular difference (u&255)-(u>>8).
no_mixing: No speech/music/TTS/existing clip inputs, no repetition/looping/channel multiplication
qa_policy: Header, length, SHA256 and time-domain peak/RMS/DC/clipping/difference/lag correlation only; no FFT/frontend/model/decoder. No post-QA amplitude/seed selection. Errors fail preparation.

streams.spectral_definition: uncorrelated triangular pseudorandom noise; not a band-limited acoustic source

streams.recipe: v[n]=16*((u&255)-(u>>8)); x[n]=round-half-away-from-zero(sum(v[n-j],j0..31)/32); negative n values zero, fixed32sample history, no pre-roll
streams.spectral_definition: 32-tap rectangular FIR moving average; H(e^jw)=(1/32)*sum(e^(-j*w*k),k0..31). Lowpass-shaped with sidelobes and zeros at500Hz multiples; NOT strictly band-limited

streams.recipe: base x=(u&255)-(u>>8). Add13 non-overlapping deterministic biphasic triangular pulses at n=(11+23*k)*16000, k0..12. A=[4096,6144,8192][k%3], overall sign=(-1)^k. For pulse sample j0..319, h=j%160; magnitude=floor(A*min(h+1,160-h)/80); sign reverses after j159. Add integer pulse to base without clipping, no fade/normalization.
streams.spectral_definition: broadband triangular background plus sparse20ms biphasic triangular transients; not band-limited
